name: What are common flooring problems found in foreclosed homes and how are they addressed?

mainEntity.name: What are common flooring problems found in foreclosed homes and how are they addressed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Foreclosed homes often present flooring issues such as water damage (from leaks or neglect), pet stains/odors, uneven subfloors, and missing sections. Water damage typically requires full removal of affected materials, drying, and potential subfloor replacement to prevent mold. Pet issues necessitate deep cleaning, odor sealing, and often subfloor treatment. Uneven subfloors are usually leveled using patching compounds or by replacing damaged sections. Addressing these underlying problems is crucial for the longevity and appearance of new flooring.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common issues include water damage, pet stains, and uneven subfloors. Solutions involve removal, drying, subfloor repair/replacement, and odor treatment.
